description: Field validation and safety rules for JeffLocal handoff JSON and dashboard case records. All rules here are enforced by deterministic code, not by the LLM.

locked_fields.description: These fields are set ONLY by deterministic code. LLM output must never set or override them.
locked_fields.enforcement: pipeline/patient_matcher.py and deterministic safety rules. Any pipeline code that allows LLM output to set these fields is a critical bug.

rules.matched: Name, DOB, and postcode all match an EMIS reference record within tolerance.
rules.possible_match: At least one identifier matches but full verification incomplete (e.g. third-party caller, DOB mismatch).
rules.no_match: No EMIS record found matching the supplied identifiers.
rules.insufficient_data: Caller refused or could not supply enough identifying information to attempt a match.

rules.true: verification_status=matched AND no red flags AND priority != 999 Emergency
rules.false: Any of: red_flags_present=true, verification_status != matched, priority = 999 Emergency

rules.999 Emergency: Red flag symptoms detected in transcript or pathway responses.
rules.urgent_same_day: Caller explicitly states urgency; no red flags.
rules.routine: Standard request, no urgency or red flag indicators.

call_id.notes: Unique per call. Used as primary key in SQLite. Format: PREFIX-DATE-HH-MM-SS-NNN

request_type.set_by: LLM extraction (Ollama/Gemma) — display field only, not a safety field

callback_number.notes: UK phone number. Stored as-supplied. Staff must verify before calling back.

dob.set_by: deterministic code only — never LLM output
dob.notes: Date of birth from patient identity block. Must match EMIS reference within tolerance for matched status.

transcript.notes: Minimum 500 characters enforced by the test harness and the voice agent. Shorter transcripts indicate a failed or garbled call.

triggers: chest pain with breathlessness or sweating
FAST stroke symptoms (face droop, arm weakness, slurred speech)
high fever with confusion and rapid breathing (sepsis)

gdpr_fields.description: Fields containing personal data subject to 90-day purge.
gdpr_fields.purge_method: Automated scheduled task; audit_events rows retained (no PII in audit log)
